reviewer_provenance.basis: Parent confirmed the actual spawn_agent invocation model and effort. No separate provider model introspection is available.
reviewer_provenance.independence: No prior audit reports, scores, improvement targets or parent conversation were read. Parent communication was limited to task scope and model provenance.

persona: Employed professional with 5–10 years of experience, little job-search time, and a confidential search. Needs relevant seniority, salary/location constraints, reusable evidence, scheduled preparation, and clear follow-ups.

live_observed: Public homepage and career-switcher audience selection
Job Loop entry redirects to sign-in while retaining professional audience in next URL
Account-free CV check through approval for two fictional applications
First PDF preview reports one page; embedded preview appeared blank
Navigation draft recovery and approval reset
limits: No authenticated account, private snapshot or real cloud run was accessed
No account creation, product data mutation, external messages, application submissions, paid calls or tool installation
No downloaded PDF/DOCX content inspection or ATS parsing
No deployment identifier proving the live site is this exact source commit
No human time-to-application study or hiring outcome measurement
No security, database permission or erasure execution audit
scope.tests: No unit tests were run or used as customer-experience evidence. Synthetic inputs were entered only into the account-free local check; no save or external send was requested.

score_method: Ten categories scored 1–100 for this persona's current AS-IS experience. Equal weight arithmetic mean. Source implementation earns qualified credit; private deployment availability and outcome claims remain unverified.

scores.rationale: Reusable source-grounded application preparation addresses a real need. Live value is principally a careful wording review; the time-saving private loop and breadth of suitable roles were not experienced.

Clear six-step free check, no account/card requirement, and professional audience carried into Job Loop sign-in. Private setup requires saving a profile, confirming shareable facts and providing or finding a vacancy before a run; that friction is source-observed only.

Live labels, progress and mobile menu were understandable; 390x844 check remained readable. The flow is long and text-heavy; the PDF iframe appeared blank. Full keyboard, contrast, screen-reader and private-loop mobile behavior remain unverified.

Live passages and contribution warnings preserved support versus leadership and projected savings. Exact PDF preview metadata and approval controls are useful. Near-exact tense variants were only partial matches, conditions were inconsistently classified, and visual/export quality of actual files was not verified.

Source defaults to three employer boards with up to four configured feeds; broader web search is conditional. Title token overlap removes seniority words, location uses text matching, and compensation minimum is not enforced by inspected selection/assessment paths. No live suitable-role yield was established.

Live second application reused CV text but still repeated review and approval. Source implements recurring rules preparation and background runs, but scheduler, pilot capacity and providers require configuration. No private unattended completion or real time saving was observed.

Source has statuses, dated follow-ups, due-action cards, run lanes and activity actors. Submission is correctly user-reported. Follow-up discovery, recipient verification and submission remain manual; no outbound reminder or calendar handoff was established in inspected paths.

Two guest journeys worked; navigation recovery preserved text and cleared approval. Source has saved runs, idempotent requests, resume/cancel, partial/failure states and document-format fallbacks. Private behavior, network failures and scheduler recovery were not executed; unsaved loop edits clear on refresh.

Live optional storage, explicit approval, no-account local check and separate saving are strong. Source separates mailbox/model permissions, shareability and scoped erasure. Discreet search is explicitly a reminder, not an employer-contact block. Account-wide deletion uses a support request and cloud security/retention was not independently verified.

I would try the free workflow. I would not yet pay $29/month on observed evidence: suitable-role yield, reliable scheduled completion and repeat-application time savings are unproven. Prices are explicitly proposed and checkout is unavailable; this is a persona judgment, not measured demand.

verdict: Useful and careful free preparation aid; not yet an evidenced low-effort ongoing search service for this employed professional.

evidence.finding: Selecting Career-switchers updated examples and CTA to /loop?audience=professional. Entering it redirected to /auth?next=%2Floop%3Faudience%3Dprofessional.

Fictional 374-character CV and 310-character first vacancy completed six stages. Findings: 0 direct, 2 partial, 4 manual review. Prepared/prepare Excel-report wording was partial. Support versus leadership was explicitly warned about; projected 8% was retained.

Salary AED 30,000 monthly and 30 October closing date were retained under rest of description rather than extracted as checked requirements. Full source remained inspectable. Second vacancy's Salary not disclosed was a manual-review finding with CV-example language; work authorization was correctly an employer condition.

First PDF preview reported one page within selected maximum. The embedded preview was blank in browser screenshot. Approval enabled PDF/DOCX/TXT/report controls after two confirmations; file downloads themselves were not verified.

After visiting pricing/privacy and returning, draft CV and first vacancy remained; approval and PDF preview were reset. For a second role, CV text was retained and old vacancy text remained until manually replaced. Second journey reached approved DOCX/TXT/report controls without a new PDF preview; PDF remained disabled.
Free pilot is for first ten accounts; actual run access is shown privately. Focus $15 and Job Loop $29 are proposed future monthly tiers. Checkout unavailable, no automatic conversion.

Disclosures differentiate local check, optional 30-minute tab recovery, Supabase saving, private loop memory, optional model/search and separate Gmail permission. Loop erasure leaves account and separate workspace records.

Default boards are Careem, GoCardless, Duolingo; configuration permits at most four feeds. Discovered roles require target/location matching, but senior/junior/graduate tokens are omitted in matching. Manual roles bypass discovery filtering.

Compensation currency, period and minimum are collected. Assessment always flags PAY_NOT_ESTABLISHED and selection uses role/location/experience signals without comparing compensation minimum. Discreet search only adds a review flag/reminder.

Daily/weekdays/weekly rules schedule with timezone/time, separate consent, next run, pause/cancel and history. Scheduler readiness and pilot allowance gate enablement. No authenticated live run or schedule was observed.
User-reported status, date-only follow-up, notes and due/upcoming cards. Optional inbox summaries depend on Gmail configuration/permission. No external reminder delivery was established.

Confirmed and shareable claims retain complete literal wording/context; revisions invalidate packets. Approval binds current inputs, formats and text. Rules output selects and orders claims; model choices cannot author arbitrary facts in these paths.

Private loop unsaved drafts retain owner-scoped memory for thirty minutes and reset confirmations on recovery; refresh clears them. Loop erasure scope is explicit. Account-wide requests rely on support receipts with no response-time promise.

time_to_application.first: Observed readiness through six guest stages and optional PDF preview, not a submitted application. Needed role/company, reviewed source CV, pasted vacancy, evidence review, wording review and two approval confirmations.
time_to_application.second: Observed retained source text plus replacement role/company/vacancy, repeated evidence/wording review and approval. It saved re-entry, not the review stages; old vacancy required deliberate replacement.
time_to_application.reason: No human stopwatch study was performed. Automation/tool latency is not a reliable measure of professional effort. No application was submitted.
time_to_application.private_loop: Source suggests confirmed facts are reusable for separate packets; actual first/second-packet latency and effort remain unverified.

top_five_actions.action: Make suitable-role coverage and constraints inspectable before setup effort
acceptance_criteria: Publicly show actual configured employer/source coverage and pilot capacity, with timestamps and failures separated from zero matches
For senior professional target fixtures, preserve seniority distinctions; show pay unknown separately from meets/below salary floor with original source quotes
Explicitly represent location/work mode and current-employer exclusions; manual overrides require review
Measure fresh suitable-role yield for agreed role/location combinations without implying interviews or placement

top_five_actions.action: Measure and reduce first- and second-application effort
acceptance_criteria: Observe employed professionals using their own redacted records; report median active minutes to approved first and second packets separately from submission
Provide a New application action that reuses career facts, blanks prior vacancy/company details and preserves the first packet
Present changed facts and job-specific gaps together while retaining exact-packet review and consent
A second application never silently retains the first vacancy or overwrites its history

top_five_actions.action: Prove scheduled preparation and return handoff
acceptance_criteria: An opted-in weekly timezone schedule executes with browser closed and records attempted/completed/partial/failed outcomes
Returning shows prepared packets and one clear review action; a missed or blocked run shows its reason and next recovery step
Pause/cancel and account-capacity states are verified end to end
Offer separately consented useful completion/follow-up reminders or calendar handoff and verify actual delivery, never auto-send applications
Offer explicit current-employer/company-domain/contact exclusions rather than relying on the discreet-search reminder
Preview exactly what will be sent to each optional provider and included in every document/draft
Verify exclusions through rules, discovery, AI, letter, evidence report and Gmail draft paths using synthetic employer secrets
Provide clear export/deletion scope and a verifiable account-wide deletion route or tracked fulfillment evidence

top_five_actions.action: Improve evidence triage and document handoff
acceptance_criteria: Near-equivalent tense variants such as prepare/prepared are handled consistently without converting support into leadership or projections into measured results
Salary, location/work mode, experience and closing date are shown as practical conditions or unknowns, with source quotes, not invitations to add CV achievements
The exact PDF is visibly inspectable on desktop and 390px mobile, with a clear fallback when embedded rendering fails
Verify PDF/DOCX/TXT preservation and readable two-page professional records before claiming export quality

unverified: Live scheduler readiness and browser-closed execution
Actual available employer feeds and relevant search yield
AI/inbox configuration, provider quality or consent execution
Private account saving, RLS/storage isolation and cloud erasure
Real follow-up reminders or calendar integration
Professional minutes saved and paid demand
Recruiter responses, interviews or employment outcomes
inferences: The confirmed-claim setup is likely a meaningful up-front burden for a long career record
Narrow feeds, weak seniority matching and no salary-floor enforcement likely reduce relevance for busy professionals
Draft reuse has value, but this reviewer would not yet pay the proposed subscription without coverage and time-saving evidence
job_outcome_guarantee: None. This review assesses preparation and organization, not hiring outcomes.
